environment.description: Laravel 10.x application deployed on a single EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with no additional security rules. Session driver is 'file' with default 120-minute lifetime. Authentication uses standard Laravel session cookies with 'lax' SameSite attribute. The application serves both the API and web frontend from the same origin. No additional request validation or origin checking is performed beyond what Laravel provides by default.

config.ALB_RULES: default forward to target group, no WAF attached
